Friday
2 AM
Three of us went in
Two people in white t-shirts at the bar laughed at us
They probably expected "better"
The bar manager, wearing a black t-shirt, "annoyed by the attitude," tried to improve his "diligence."
I wish you a better future.

Worst place I visited in Torre. i went to Aqua the night before and expected here to be similar. Its tiny, more straight women than Aqua, fairly quiet at 2.30am in Sat with soul destroying music. I paid 15€ to get in and didn't even finish my free drink. I only stayed 20 minutes before realising there was no way it could ever get better. my only happy memory of the place is that the doorman asked 'did i not like it there?' as i left. I was too annoyed to respond to. also no stamp to allow re-entry, like other bars. if i had this i may have tried to pop in later. Avoid!

RESPONSE: the response below says something about the attitude of the people there.

1. it was my first time in Torremolinos
2. this was my genuine experience and i left as it was awful
3. I wasnt offered re-entry. As a new tourist  you would think the doorman may realise to offer after i wasted €15 for 20 minutes. Other places insisted my arm was stamped at entry to confirm payment.

The response confirms that there are toxic people there. And there is something to be said about not be allowed to have an opinion. If you dont say its great, you just get shot virtually. And reading responses to other reviews, it does feel like friends may be trying to keep the reviews better.

The rest of Torremolinos was lovely. So I would reiterate to tourists to not go to this place due to the attitude and overall vibe. Many many other bars there which are better.
The truth is, the doorman was really rude to us, he treated us terribly, and people were smoking downstairs in the bathrooms. A real dive.

In my opinion, it's outdated, the music is very repetitive with too much reggaeton. I think it should be more varied and play more with the 90s and 2000s, which for me is the era with the best tracks... (in response to the owner's reply): Look who's talking about being outdated and bitter... the one who still has "Forbidden" on the sign 25 years later and hasn't changed the decor since 2001, hahaha. Your responses to customers show your lack of manners, which, by the way, match the pathetic dive you run.

one_star_reviews.text:
The idea of ​​offering electric vehicle charging points is good, but the parking policy completely undermines the service.

I've charged my car here several times because the parking lot is open and it's convenient to leave the vehicle while it charges. However, if you don't make a purchase exceeding €50, they charge €0.04 per minute of parking. In my case, a 3-hour charge cost me €7.20 for parking, in addition to the cost of the electricity.

After being charged over €7 just for parking while charging, I decided not to use this service again. I believe that customers using the charging point shouldn't also have to pay for parking, or at least they should have a few free hours while charging. As it's currently structured, it forces you to spend more than €50 to avoid the charge, which doesn't always make sense. It's no wonder the charger is almost always available: these conditions certainly don't encourage its use.

I'm convinced this is a 5 star establishment were one to be able to access it. My rating is for Google. Contrary to what Google tells me.ascwitj so many things in Vigo in particular and Europe in general, this place is NOT open right now, or at all on Sunday.  Nor is there any tourist office in the place indicated.   The maps hav
e ' poor' ( actually nonexistent) accuracy. It appears that Google can't actually help with anything that isn't the standard US gridded city layout.
Infuriating at every turn.

A very disappointing experience

About five or six years ago, we visited this café for the first time and had wonderful memories. On that occasion, we were served by a lovely, very kind and professional young woman who made our experience truly enjoyable.

That's why we were so disappointed to return now and find ourselves receiving completely different treatment. The woman who served us this time, the one with glasses, had an attitude that we found very unpleasant, cold, and unprofessional. We felt uncomfortable the entire time and, frankly, disrespected as customers.

It's a shame that a place we were fond of because of that first experience left us with this feeling. It's not about demanding special treatment, simply about receiving a minimum of kindness, courtesy, and respect.

After this experience, we know for sure that we won't be returning, nor will we recommend the establishment to family or friends. Customer service can make all the difference, and in this case, unfortunately, the difference was for the worse.

one_star_reviews.text:
Yesterday, September 4th, in the late afternoon/evening, I went to exchange a gift. I didn't find anything that caught my eye, so I asked for a voucher. Then I saw something and bought it, paying the difference because it was more expensive.
Today I went back because I wasn't convinced, and as soon as I entered the store, I noticed the two saleswomen, who had helped me yesterday and who, by the way, didn't seem very friendly, talking amongst themselves about me. I ended up exchanging something, which they seemed to find tedious, judging by the way they looked at each other. And when I left, I saw them again.

I don't think I bothered them at all, nor was I pushy, so I think it's disrespectful. What I mean is that I've worked in this same sector for years and I've never whispered in front of a customer, firstly because it's very noticeable and the truth is that the attention was very poor. Not every day can someone have a good day, but there's no need to be so blatant because it makes you feel uncomfortable.

one_star_reviews.text: The apartment offers a magnificent view and is very spacious, but unfortunately, it has many problems. Furthermore, the place is particularly dirty. The bathroom smells so strongly of sewage that you have to keep the door closed and the ventilation on to avoid suffocating. The kitchen utensils, especially the dishes, are old or broken, and the dishwasher is out of order. In addition, the refrigerator makes an infernal noise at night. It's impossible to cook if the air conditioning or heating is on: as soon as you use the stovetop, the circuit breaker trips. The worst part, however, is the landlord: extremely stingy, he demands a security deposit that will only be returned after receiving the water and electricity bills. Because the apartment's plumbing is outdated, the bills are always high, and he takes advantage of this to keep a good portion of the deposit. Beware! Don't get scammed: never pay in cash and always demand a receipt!

one_star_reviews.text:
I usually leave positive reviews, but in this case, I feel compelled to share my experience. The initial consultation was friendly, and the doctor explained things very well, but my experience with the Botox treatment was very negative: the effect completely wore off in less than a month. Based on how the treatment progressed, I believe the Botox wasn't applied correctly and that the result is due to poor technique or practice.

At the touch-up appointment, her attitude was defensive from the very beginning, even before I could explain the problem, instead of initially focusing on finding solutions. She justified the result mainly by citing the brand used (Bocouture) and my pre-existing medical conditions.

I've used that same brand and others in the past, with the exact same medical history, always achieving long-lasting results and the desired finish. Therefore, I don't believe my medical history alone explains why the effect disappeared completely in less than a month this time, nor the specific brand of Botox.

In fact, the doctor herself later acknowledged in writing that, in my case, Bocouture "clearly falls short," that there is some effect but not the one I was looking for in terms of finish and duration, and she suggested using Relfydess for future applications at a compensatory price. I appreciate the acknowledgment that the result was insufficient, but I believe the problem wasn't simply that I was looking for a specific result, but rather that the effect of the Botox wore off abnormally quickly.

I wanted to combine treatments here because the dermatology care is excellent, but my experience with cosmetic medicine has been very negative. For my part, I will not be repeating this treatment at the clinic.

She's a terrible person; she's caused me depression. I was transferred here from another province because I moved to Ponferrada, and she didn't care about my medical records. She's seriously worsened my health and called me selfish for wanting surgery, saying that nothing would happen until I had cancer. She prescribed Tramadol for months, telling me to take it "like candy," and asking her what I was telling her when I told her the medication made me feel unwell. one_star_reviews.text: Terrible experience. I absolutely do not recommend it. If you want couples therapy, go somewhere else. We got off to a bad start when they asked for money upfront (€680), gave us an appointment, and then automatically canceled it for a month. Obviously, we're talking about psychological issues, but also financial ones. If you're going to make me pay, at least provide a service. And it only got worse. The therapy was very amateurish, with no in-depth analysis of our profiles and very superficial, lacking any real tools. A young woman with no experience and very little background. Finally, I requested a report, which took about two weeks, and only because I had to write to them again. The management was poor, the therapy was poor. I do not recommend it. - Response to the response: I clicked on that link and I can't complain about anything; it's just another website saying how great you are. Now that time has passed and I can see it with perspective, and I've spoken with other professionals, you did a terrible job with me and my then-partner. Psychologists are there to confront and demonstrate that each person's actions have direct effects and consequences on their own lives and the lives of those around them. That young woman only succeeded in making a self-centered, egotistical man think I was the crazy one—very fitting in these times. She focused on my anxiety, caused by many past misfortunes, and not on her own lack of empathy, causing me irreversible harm.

one_star_reviews.text:
A bad experience and disappointing management.

Last November, I booked several treatments at Clínica Londres, including Dermapen and Indiba, using a credit I had outstanding. Specifically, I booked three Dermapen sessions and five Indiba sessions.

The problem arose from an internal error in the paperwork. When I went for one of the Indiba sessions, Natalia, the professional in charge of my treatments, didn't have the corresponding document printed and asked me to sign another one. I explicitly warned her that this wasn't the correct document and that, by signing it, a session I hadn't actually received would be recorded as completed. Her response was that I shouldn't worry, that she would personally handle the sessions, and that there wouldn't be any problem.

Later, when I wanted to schedule my final Dermapen session, Natalia told me I had to wait a month due to the hyaluronic acid treatment I had received on May 19, 2026. Since summer was approaching, we agreed to postpone it until after the holidays, which she readily accepted.

I was shocked when, upon calling last week to schedule that pending session, I was informed that Natalia no longer worked at the clinic and that they would not take any action to resolve the issue, because their records contained my signature, and according to them, that was final.

The most disappointing aspect was the treatment I received from Gema, the director. Instead of listening to my explanation and trying to find out what had happened, she made comments implying how suspicious it was that I had called right after Natalia left. Natalia left on a Tuesday, and I called on Thursday. I want to make it clear that I have no connection to her, I don't know where she currently works, and I have no knowledge of her personal circumstances. I simply called to request a session I had scheduled.

Furthermore, there are WhatsApp messages confirming my Dermapen and Indiba appointments that can help verify what happened. I'm not asking for a favor or trying to take advantage of any situation. I'm simply requesting a service I contracted for, the last session of which was postponed after a specific conversation with the professional who was treating me.

I find it unacceptable that an internal error in document management should end up harming the client, especially since I pointed out at the time that I was signing an incorrect document and was assured there wouldn't be any problem. For them to now hide behind a signature, without considering my explanations or attempting to verify the facts, seems to me a highly unprofessional way to resolve an issue.

After having trusted the clinic and invested a significant amount of money in their treatments, I expected, at the very least, that they would listen to my side of the story and try to find a reasonable solution. Instead, I felt questioned and treated as if I were trying to deceive the clinic. Terrible treatment and Gema as director leaves much to be desired.

I had a very disappointing consultation with Dr. Celia Sánchez Acedo regarding a complex revision rhinoplasty.

Before booking, I clearly explained the type of surgery I needed and expected to meet with someone who had substantial experience in revision rhinoplasty. During the appointment, the doctor told me she had performed approximately 20 rhinoplasties. However, she did not have any before-and-after photographs, comparable revision cases, or other results available for me to review. Afterward, I searched for her professional background and could not find any publicly available evidence of specialization in rhinoplasty or revision rhinoplasty, patient reviews, or a surgical portfolio.

The consultation began approximately 15 minutes late, lasted only around 30 minutes, and cost €114. Most of the appointment focused on describing the problems with my existing nose, without providing a constructive surgical plan or explaining how she could realistically improve it. I was simply asked to obtain the records from my previous surgery.

I also later noticed that Clínica Londres’ website advertises the first medical consultation as “always free,” despite my being charged €114 for an external medical consultation.

Patients seeking a complicated revision deserve to know a surgeon’s specific level of experience and see comparable results before paying for a consultation. Based on my experience, I did not receive the specialized guidance or reassurance that I had clearly requested when booking.

Disappointing. I went to this clinic precisely because it advertises itself as specializing in lipedema and because, supposedly, the first visit, costing €100, includes various techniques for a precise and personalized diagnosis.

After waiting 45 minutes, the consultation lasted barely 10 minutes. They simply looked at my legs and told me I had lipedema, without performing any tests or assessments beyond a visual inspection. For me, that's not a specialized diagnosis.

The supposed action plan consisted of telling me to follow a healthy diet and exercise, without even asking what kind of diet I follow or what kind of exercise I do. They also recommended using compression garments and mentioned that lipedema might improve with menopause and that I might be a candidate for INDIBA therapy.

I already knew everything they told me; the only information they provided was the model of compression garment. I left without a truly personalized assessment, without concrete guidelines, and without an action plan.

In the end, they charged me €50 instead of the advertised €100. I appreciate it, but after this experience, I think even €50 is excessive for such a superficial consultation.

one_star_reviews.text:
Our experience has been VERY DISAPPOINTING, especially given the difficult times we are living through.

We had a reservation made almost a month ago for a very special service: a boat trip to scatter my father's ashes and say goodbye to him. We had organized everything well in advance, and we even had family members traveling from out of town specifically for that day. Yesterday, with very little notice, they called us to say that we had to change the date and time because another family wanted to have the exact same service. We explained that it was impossible for us to change it, since our family was traveling from out of town, but apparently, they didn't care. Their solution was for my family to change the date.

Frankly, we find it hard to understand how a reservation confirmed almost a month ago can be changed like this simply because another family wants the same service. And, although I can't say for sure what the real reason was (we'll never know), I think our reservation was taken away because the other option was more financially advantageous for them. If we already had a prior reservation, the logical and professional thing to do would have been to honor it and, if it's true that another family was interested in the service, offer them another date, not ask us to change our plans at the last minute, with our reservation more than confirmed.

What hurts us the most is that we're not talking about an excursion or a plan that can simply be changed. We're talking about saying goodbye to a loved one and a moment that was unique and unrepeatable for our family. We expected a minimum of empathy, professionalism, responsibility, and respect for such a special reservation and such a delicate moment.

Completely unprofessional, with zero empathy and zero respect. The day before my father's ashes ceremony, he contacted me to change the time. I told him it wasn't possible, and he offered to change the date, which was impossible. My family was traveling from out of town specifically to say goodbye to my father; everything was already organized since we had the date reserved and confirmed 20 days in advance. He called me back, gave me explanations... Personally, I think he got another job that would be more profitable and decided to leave us hanging the day before. Anyway... I hope he profited from it and that this serves him well, and above all, that something similar doesn't happen to him when he has to say goodbye to a family member.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with the treatment management has been very negative.

The treatment consisted of three sessions, and from the first session, I was charged the price listed on the clinic's website. For over a month and a half, that was the amount I was quoted and paid.

Just two days before the third session, they contacted me by phone to tell me that, due to an alleged internal error, I had been charged incorrectly and that I owed an additional €100. I explained that I had paid exactly the amount that had been quoted from the beginning and that it also matched the price published on their own website.

Despite this, they later insisted via WhatsApp that the price I had paid was incorrect. I even sent them a screenshot of the website, dated today, where the same price they had initially charged me was still displayed. Only then did they retract their complaint.

What disappointed me most wasn't just the error itself, but how it was handled: demanding payment from the customer more than a month later, attributing the problem to an internal issue, repeatedly contacting them by phone and text message, and finally discovering that the claim wasn't even valid. Furthermore, the apologies were minimal, and there was no concessionary gesture or customer service appropriate to the situation.

If there's an internal billing error, it shouldn't be passed on to the customer, much less should an additional payment be demanded after the amount communicated and published by the clinic itself has already been paid.

A very unsatisfactory experience in terms of communication, transparency, and customer service.

A week ago I got a semi-permanent manicure and pedicure. Today they told me I'd have to come back because several of my nails had chipped.

I waited for over an hour between the wait and the removal of my nails. Since they had to remove more than five nails, they offered to redo the set; however, while my set was being removed, apparently by the salon manager, the two manicurists continued attending to clients who came in later. So, once the entire set was removed, she told me I had to keep waiting until one of the manicurists was free, even though they were just starting to work on two other clients.

Therefore, I waited for over an hour and still had to wait for the manicurists to finish the sets they had just started, plus the time it would take to do my new set. I don't understand why they don't schedule appointments for these kinds of cases and leave you waiting until the very end when they've had a bad experience.

On the other hand, the person who did my nail extension removal didn't seem to have any training or experience, as she left my nails in chunks and the removal itself was far from ideal. Of course, she was just killing time while the two manicurists worked on other nails.

Finally, the quality of the pedicure was also disappointing, but who can complain after seeing the service they provide? And to top it all off, you end up spending money trying to fix the mess at home. Avoid going to this place.

one_star_reviews.text: Had a very unfortunate experience at this garage. I took my Citroen C3 for a routine cam belt change as per Citroen/Peugeot scheduled  Maintenance. (The car was absolutely fine when I went in).  I was given a quote and I asked if that was for everything which the receptionist replied it was. This should include, according to Citroen, oil and filter change with a cleaner, removal of sump, oil strainer cleaned and VVT valve cleaned. The reason for the elaborate procedure is when the belt is changed, because it is a 'wet' belt' (ie goes through the oil), particles of the belt always shred and particles from the belt contaminate the previous listed parts.  I was called to say the car was ready for collection but when I arrived the car was still on the ramp as they said they had to re code the key. (Why this was so I have no idea because it is not in any way related to the cam belt change). The car was then taken from the ramp to the forecourt while we were waiting in reception. I pulled on to the N332 and the car immediately went into limp mode meaning an engine fault. I returned to the garage and was told as it was a Friday evening that they would not be able to look at it until the Monday morning and lent me a courtesy car. Had a call on Monday afternoon to say the car was ready and my wife and son went to collect it. I was then given a bill for 364.68e - this was on top of the original bill for the job which was 539.26e. In other words I have had to pay out twice because of their negligence and incompetence because the job was not done correctly in the first place. We filled out the reclamation book and have since emailed three times to the manager and under manager and so far neither party has had the courtesy to acknowledge our communication or answer it. So from my experience, the customer service and the mechanical service was absolutely appalling. Having spoken to a colleague who was the Managing Director of Citroen UK - the full procedure is 'statutory' because if it is not undertaken it can cause major engine damage. I am a retired mechanic with over 47 years of extensive experience in the motor trade. My car was not test driven before it was given back to me the first time round as I was sitting in the office waiting for it and then I discovered my internal camera had been removed from the windscreen and is now broken. When the car was finally returned the second time, there were oily hand marks all over the wings. I just found the whole experience totally unsatisfactory.

I got the Korean eyelash lift last month by rude lady.
I don’t speak Spanish but I was trying my best to communicate, because of that or what,
She was harsh and rude plus, the lift was quite bad as got straight after 2days already😅
And right side was no even lifted well.
When she was drying the glue, she was blowing my eyes by her breathing which was super shocking.
Because Korean beauty salon will never blow your eyes by your breath😅
So you should not name this service as “Korean “ at least.
It was good price because of coupon so it is what it is but I was pretty shock for all of this experience.
Maybe they are nice to local but for tourist better avoid this place 100%!

I absolutely do not recommend this place; they prioritize money over people. I was subsidized and noticed the difference in treatment compared to those paying. They're very money-grubbing, overcharging for the products you order there, and to top it all off, they don't make it easy to get your money back when you leave. Also, be aware of the medication; they gave me a severe case of pills, and I had to be hospitalized because of the effects. Not recommended; they only care about money.
It said it was open, but there was no activity.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'd give it fewer stars if I could.

My experience with this gynecologist has been very negative. From the very first moment, the treatment was excessively informal, as if we were just "colleagues," something I personally consider completely inappropriate in a doctor-patient relationship, especially when there is no prior trust.

What worried me most was the lack of interest and explanation regarding the tests and results I brought to the appointment. She didn't review my analyses in a way that I could understand, nor did she explain what the results meant or answer my questions. I left the appointment feeling that my situation hadn't been properly assessed.

Furthermore, my daughter is also her patient and takes the birth control pill. In our experience, no follow-up or monitoring related to this treatment is being carried out, which also worries me considerably.

On top of all this, there was a delay of at least an hour and a half in the appointment, without even receiving an apology for the wait.

I fully understand that delays can occur in medicine and that each professional may have a different way of treating their patients, but I believe that medical care should include genuine interest, review of tests, clear explanations, and a professional approach. Unfortunately, in our case, we found none of this and were not satisfied with the care we received.

one_star_reviews.text:
Completely inadequate professional and personal treatment.

Part 1. Original Review: "Completely deficient professional and personal treatment. I was very disappointed with the treatment I received yesterday when I went to the clinic. I had an appointment scheduled by phone last week, and when I arrived, I was told that Dr. Raquel Medina was the only one seeing patients and that she couldn't see me through my insurance company, only as a private patient, with me having to pay the corresponding fee out of pocket. I expressed my concern about my eye health and the symptoms I'm experiencing to reception, and they replied that they couldn't give me an appointment with a doctor who accepts private insurance for another 20 days. I asked to speak with the Clinic Manager, Dr. Medina, in person to explain what had happened, and meanwhile, the reception staff listened to the recording of the conversation with the virtual assistant when I requested the appointment. Dr. Raquel stated that she took responsibility for the error made by her own clinic, since the insurance company under which I requested the appointment could be heard in the recording. However, the solution she offered was for me to PAY the private fee." She told me to examine her or to come back in 20 days. I told her the mistake was her clinic's, and as such, she offered no solution other than charging me the full price for the consultation, which I couldn't afford. This kind of treatment leaves much to be desired, and I also consider it inadequate professional treatment, since she showed no interest in my eye health or my symptoms. She didn't ask me anything. My conclusion was to request a complaint form, since as a patient, I couldn't think of anything else... How sad to see such professional behavior from a highly regarded doctor..."

Part 2. To the attention of Dr. Raquel Medina: Regarding the response to my review, I reply: At no point did I request to speak with the manager, Dr. Raquel Medina, in the waiting room, but she did decide to see me there. Therefore, the only thing this review does is confirm an even less humane and professional experience, since when I requested to speak with the manager, I received nothing more than two sentences from her in the middle of the waiting room at the entrance. Therefore, both in form and content, the treatment I received was completely deficient. In my original review, I accurately reflected what happened, which I will summarize again: Dr. Raquel indicated that it was indeed an error on the part of her own ophthalmology center, but the solution she offered was: 1. To return in 20 days for an eye health consultation, without knowing the reason or problem with my eyes for which I was attending the appointment, which the center had scheduled for me a week earlier by telephone. 2. To pay as a private consultation at their standard rate. Of course, my review is not positive for the center; Given the treatment I received, I believe it's important that users have the option to read about reality, both the good, which I don't doubt exists, and the undesirable aspects, which I experienced firsthand in this case. Everything reflected here is a true reflection of reality.

one_star_reviews.text:
When you call to request the sealing of bidet taps (due to a possible micro-leak) and the drain, what service do you offer?

I thought I had a homemade leak and called a professional to put my mind at ease about a potential leak in the near future.

I had new plugs because after months of unnoticed leaks, they seemed rusty and strained. I offered them to him, but he thought it was better to reuse the ones that were already in place. I watched how he carried out the "repair" because you can always learn something new. He proceeded to remove the old thread using a screwdriver and then applied sealing thread and Teflon tape simultaneously, and now we'll see.

I mentioned that I hadn't unclogged the drain because I suspected it might be leaking there too. At first glance, he said he knew it was fine. I repeatedly asked if it would be possible to check because one of the taps also had visible white sealant, and it seemed to be leak-free, but it was. So there was no certainty.

And it wasn't until I showed up with a hammer to check it myself, so I could witness it, because that "it's fine" assessment alone isn't enough. And indeed, after his hurried departure, having removed some of the remaining sealant, I proceeded to clean up the debris and dust. I did the paper test... and it did wet...

I paid for a "service" that lasted less than half an hour. Because to check for watertightness, his advice was simply, "leave the door open, let it air out and dry."

I hope this information is useful to someone.

And to top it all off, he started banging on a tile to warn me that it sounded hollow and that there was a crack. My first thought was to try and extract some metal, but that's just ridiculous...

It's appalling how little management companies like the ones running this place care about people's vacations and their time. It's a shame. It could have been a good experience, but it turned into a nightmare. They came to investigate the source of the smells but were unable to fix it. A very bad experience. On Booking.com, it says they offered me an alternative. Only for the last day, and on the second floor, which required carrying a stroller, a baby, and a toddler. I don't know what they say on Booking.com. The manager was unpleasant. I hope the owner changes staff or that I have the option to speak with him directly. A very bad experience. I hope the next one doesn't smell like excrement for days.

We will never again enter this negligent parking garage where absolutely nothing works; the barrier wouldn't even open with the ticket they gave us. one_star_reviews.text: Why do they never answer the phone? NEVER. You can spend 20 minutes listening to the recording that they'll be with you shortly. I've been there many times and I've never seen anyone sitting there very busy.

They can't treat heroin withdrawal the same as cocaine withdrawal; going there without a phone is like going into depression; the occupational therapist is very lazy, only good for sitting around; the food is low quality; I requested a voluntary discharge, submitting my reports stating that I had an insomnia problem when it started there due to lack of activity; the facilities, which should have a small gym, a couple of stationary bikes, dumbbells...

Over 40 years ago, my grandmother was hospitalized there. She was always a depressive woman, and her experience there must have been so traumatic that she never went to another psychiatric center. She lived her life depressed, with family support and heavy medication, but she never wanted to be hospitalized. I'm currently in a severe depressive state, and every time I hear the name of this place, something inside me tells me that they've left an incurable wound on many people instead of helping them. I don't know if they've changed their therapies, methodology, or staff by 2026... but it will always have a bad reputation.

Unfortunately, we were rather disappointed with our visit overall. The restaurant tries to create an upscale, modern gourmet atmosphere, but for us, the overall experience did not quite live up to that standard.

What was particularly disappointing was that we were served clearly damaged/chipped plates. For a restaurant that aims to present itself as high-end and charges accordingly, we simply expect clean and undamaged tableware.

We also expected more from the food. Overall, the price-performance ratio did not feel right to us.

The staff, however, were very kind, friendly, and attentive. We would definitely like to give them credit for that. ❤️

It’s a shame, because the concept and location have a lot of potential. Unfortunately, it was not an experience we would repeat.

one_star_reviews.text:
Disappointing and a rip-off. That's how I would describe the service I received from the doctor.

After waiting more than a month and a half for an appointment (it's very popular), I finally got one the first week of September. She was over 40 minutes late, and despite explaining my ear pain symptoms, which are preventing me from living a normal life with my partner and affecting my ability to teach my students, she told me my solution would be to wear earplugs for the rest of my life, but that she would still look into my case. This cost me €150 and lasted 20 minutes. She said she would call me back three days later.

After two weeks, I called and they left a message saying I had called. Nothing. I called again days later, and even the poor receptionist seemed embarrassed by my situation.

After more than three weeks, I finally got Dr. Itziar to call me back, ask me the same questions as in our consultation, and recommend a psychologist to help me deal with the symptoms. Just in case they traumatize me.

Absolutely shameful.

A disappointing experience due to the lack of professionalism and the feeling we were left with because he didn't keep his word.

In March, Jaime came to our house to assess the work and repairs we had requested.

He told us he would do them in July. It was impossible for him to do them any sooner.
Since he hadn't contacted us by the end of June, after several calls and WhatsApp messages, we finally managed to get in touch with him. Thinking he might be very busy, I told him that, despite what we had agreed, it was enough for him to fix the two leaks we had told him about.
In the end, he didn't come in July but in August.

And he only fixed one leak, and only after we practically begged him to, and even then, just a small room. He didn't want to know anything about the other leak (we pleaded with him because of its importance) or the rest of what we had agreed upon. He left us high and dry, and with the rainy season just around the corner, it's now impossible for us to find a professional to fix the leak.
He has completely let us down. Our experience tells us we can't trust him. If you don't want to do a repair or whatever, please don't make commitments and play games with people. If you make a commitment, keep it.

Price

one_star_reviews.text: The switchboard system is a disaster. What good is a modern building if the important and valuable thing is customer service? They never answer the phone; there's just a recording that clicks off, telling me to call back later. Sometimes I've gone to the main desk myself, and there are these people who don't answer the phone. They should be replaced, just like they did with some psychologists and psychiatrists. Although they're young, you can see the interest they show in attending to and listening to the patient.

I've called 10 times to cancel a duplicate appointment, precisely so they can free it up for someone who really needs it. With the current appointment system and the long wait times, it's crucial to be able to release an appointment when you no longer need it.

The worst part is they don't answer the phone, and I don't live close enough to travel just to cancel. It's infuriating trying to do something so simple and not being able to get through. 😔 They really need to improve their phone service and make it much easier to cancel appointments. 💔

It is especially disappointing because initially it seemed that we were dealing with a knowledgeable and professional person, but over time we have been able to verify the real quality of some of the work: poor finishes, problems that they have not wanted to take on and a very unprofessional way of handling complaints.

In addition, talking to him when there is a problem is very complicated because of his bad temper and bad manners.

In short, a very negative experience. What at first seemed like a good renovation has ended up being a constant source of problems and expenses, and now we have to pay again for another professional to fix a job that we had already paid for.

one_star_reviews.text:
Terrible customer service after several years of doing business with this company.
I bought their film and received EnerCut credits with my purchases. With around 20 credits still remaining, they simply switched off my access without any warning or prior discussion.
The reality is that the main reason I continued buying their film was to maintain access to EnerCut as a backup cutting software. In my experience, compared with Llumar, their film is simply in a different league, and not in a good way. I was comfortable using it for some dealership work, but I would not choose it for my regular retail customers.
When I questioned why my access had been removed, instead of resolving the issue I received arrogant and defensive replies and was suddenly told about “policies” that had never been an issue during years of doing business with them.
Their previous staff were always friendly and helpful, despite changing several times over the years. My latest experience has been completely different.
I honestly don't care about the value of the remaining credits anymore. It's the principle. Cutting off a long-term customer without warning and then arguing about credits connected with products already purchased is an embarrassing way to run a business.
Poor product compared with the alternatives I use, and now equally poor customer service.
I won't be buying from them again!
